proof_attempt_summary: Discovery developed the unbounded five-action Gaussian game, universal original-record attainer, and an original-record empirical-Bellman strict-gap theorem. D0.5 found the fixed two-visit saturated scope incremental against the field floor, with score ceiling 6.2 below 7.4 and no bounded in-scope repair. The run stopped before Lean formalization; numerical-certificate reproducibility, the generic Gaussian comparator, and a matched published empirical-Bellman workflow remain unresolved.
tldr: Nested cessation ties couple four continuation policies through a parallelogram, while immediate stop supplies a fifth action. In the saturated ten-record, nine-coordinate, two-stage model, the exact local expected causal-regret constant at scale \(n^{-1/2}\) is the three-contrast Gaussian square-pyramid value \(v(\Sigma(\lambda_0))\). A terminating certified primal and dual computation approximates this unbounded game and its rule to arbitrary error, including every boundary face and tail. The full original-record experiment supplies a matching lower bound over all randomized learners, and one total covariance-adaptive data-only sequence attains the value at every interior tied law. Empirical Bellman is strictly suboptimal on a nonempty relatively open attainable covariance neighborhood: its original-record scaled regret exceeds the exact local minimax constant by at least \(31/10000>3/1000\). The result is a restricted subfield technical kernel; scalar binary benefit is a decision benchmark without clinical safety certification.
gap: Stopping-policy learning supplies regret rates, local treatment-choice theory supplies experiment reductions, and Stoye (2009) supplies exact binary finite-sample minimax analysis. Manski and Tetenov (2016) supply multiple-treatment sufficient empirical-success trial-size guarantees. These results inform the target; no tightening of their published model classes is claimed. The rank separation explains why unrestricted independent trial arms do not substitute for the nested stopping experiment. The open target is its unbounded constrained five-policy game, a universal original-record attainer, and a certified empirical-Bellman classification.
fill: The full likelihood determines the covariance and keeps nuisance directions in the converse. Independent screening and the finite face lattice provide a concrete calibration handle. Smoothed empirical ratios, covariance inflation and independently selected certified rules provide a handle for one total attaining learner. Covariance-risk continuity supports a legal open-set strict-gap certificate; the alternative is an all-rule equality certificate throughout the attainable family. The supporting separation proposition derives the independent-trial contrast rank and stopping gain relation rather than assuming a comparator estimand.
